Name: UV's Alternate Cats
Author: Unbr0k3nVessel
Description:
[b]WELCOME TO UV'S ALTERNATE CAT[/b]

[b]ABOUT THE MOD[/b]

This is a small mod package that I am working to build out with new pets and animals so that farm cats can become new and fun animals.

[b]FEATURES[/b]

[b]Version 1.0.3 Update[/b]
At the moment the pack adds 12 new breeds of cats to the game:
[list]
[*]Bee
[*]Possum
[*]B'st (inspired by Evil Empire's Sea of Stars with hand drawn assets)
[*]Fox + Arctic Fox
[*]Snail
[*]Cinnamoroll (Inspied by the Sanrio Cast)
[*]Junimos of varying colors (Green, Blue, Red, Yellow & Rainbow)
[/list]
-Frog assets and other animals will be added in future versions of the pack as I return to this mod. (I will be spending more time with different mods in the immediate future)
-The mod has had some polishing done before publication to iron out visual assets issues. I am still working to learn how to better polish the pets behaviors to match their texture assets as well as improve compatibility with gifts and presence in the 100% end-game cutscene.
-While the added cats will visually appear as different animals, I have yet to adjust their "BarkOveride" field so they will still meow like cats.
-NOTE: This mod does not "reskin" existing cats, but rather adds new breeds accessible through adoption via Marnie's shop

[b]HOW TO INSTALL
[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI
[*]Install Content Patcher
[*]Add mod files to your game's "Mods" folder
[*]Run the game to generate a config.JSON file, or use the default file included in the mod files (includes all 12 options by default)
[*]Use a text editor like VSCode, Atom.io or Notepad to edit the "Cat Breeds" field in the config.JSON file
[*]Save the file
[*]Run the game and enjoy playing with your new goofy animal friends
[/list]
NOTE: This mod is currently not compatible with coop play unless all players have the mod installed and identical configuration files allowing for the same breeds in-game. Further testing is needed to identify possible errors in a coop environment with varying configuration alignments.

[b]NOTE FROM THE AUTHOR[/b]

Lastly, I am not a developer nor artist by trade so I apologize for any issues as I am learning this process, please be gentle with me =)! As a product manager I am always open to feedback, ideas and resources from the community and would love to continually add to this project and any other mods I publish over time.

If nothing else I hope this silly little side project can make someone out there smile or bring a little extra light to a game and community that is already so beautiful.

Peace and Love,

﻿Unbr0k3n Vessel =)
